nodes.label: Logits / sampling
notes: Truncate collected logits to V. Sampler internals excluded from FLOPs; max_num_seqs*V*fp32 included in memory peak.
Curated fixture, not production extraction/lowering. Per-rank bytes; decimal GB=10^9, GiB=2^30. TP1/TP4 weight totals and shapes match experiment exactly.
All symbols/metric dimensions are expression strings; source line numbers are provenance integers. T/S are local to one attention DP replica; context is separate cache length.
Group metrics summarize descendants; decoder summarizes L/pp layers. For totals use memory.weights, never sum all nodes.
PP choices deliberately divide L; first/last embeddings live on different stages for pp>1. Memory ledger chooses the final stage with the extra final norm as the heaviest equal-size rank.
EP=1 disables EP; otherwise ep=tp*dp and E must be divisible by ep. EP and dp>1 formulas are uniform-routing estimates, not CPU/mock verified facts.
TP node weights describe a representative local decoder stage. L0 endpoint weights are whole endpoint tensors; stage residency is applied in memory.weights.
No latency predictions; bytes_moved, activation peaks and uncalibrated overheads are transparent approximations.

S.description: Local decode sequences; one generated token per sequence per step.

T.description: Local attention tokens in one prefill chunk, independent of cache length.

batch.description: Equal-length sequences within a prefill chunk. T must be divisible by batch.

block_size.description: KV tokens per cache block; device/backend restrictions apply.

context.description: Existing cache length per decode sequence in tokens; uniform length approximation.

dp.description: Independent attention data parallel replicas; T and S are local to one replica.

dtype_a.description: Activation dtype; router/logits may internally accumulate in fp32.

dtype_ids.description: Token index dtype; bytes(dtype_ids) is supported; token index storage is excluded from the metric ledger.

dtype_kv.description: Stored KV dtype; quantized KV scales are not modelled.

dtype_w.description: Stored weight dtype; fixture excludes quantization scales and packing overhead.

ep.description: Expert parallel degree: 1 disables EP, otherwise must equal tp*dp (vLLM flattened expert group).

gpu_memory_utilization.description: Fraction of device memory available to vLLM.

hbm_bytes.description: Device memory budget in bytes (decimal 64 GB default, user configurable).

max_num_batched_tokens.description: Token count used for chunked-prefill memory profiling.

non_torch_bytes.description: Configured non-torch byte deduction; default excludes unknown HCCL workspace.

pp.description: Pipeline stages. Fixture supports equal partitions only; custom/uneven PP needs explicit rank ledgers.

reserved_bytes.description: Additional reserved byte deduction; default excludes graph capture and fragmentation.

tp.description: Attention tensor parallel degree. Must divide Hq and be compatible with Hkv.
